_comment: The runtime this integration is measured against. Section 18: never benchmark a release claim against a moving main. Changing any value here invalidates every real-result.json produced before the change.

_second_model_note: This block pins the SCORED model. The same commit and the same hook also run Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, a sparse-MoE hybrid whose geometry lives in configs/qwen3.6-35b-a3b-moe-ceiling.json - the adapter derives every stride from the runtime's config, so a second model needs a geometry file and no code change. Results in results/rtx5090-moe-matrix.json. Changing THIS block invalidates every real-result.json produced before the change; adding a second model's geometry elsewhere does not.
